name: check_business_hours
description: Check business hours, service fee, and booking eligibility. Call this AFTER collecting the customer's issue description. You MUST pass both is_hplus_member (from check_service_area) and is_emergency (true if customer has NO cooling or NO heat).

is_hplus_member.description: Whether customer is a verified H+ member. Use the is_hplus_member value returned from check_service_area, NOT what the customer claimed.

is_emergency.description: Set to TRUE if: AC not working at all (no cooling), furnace/heat not working at all (no heat), house is very hot or very cold, baby/elderly/medical condition affected. Set to FALSE if: AC/heat running but not great, making noise, maintenance request, tune-up, quote request.
